description: Source code for the TCPDFEngine class, a PDF engine implementation extending PDFEngine, utilizing TCPDF library for PDF generation within SuiteCRM.

classes.name: TCPDFEngine
classes.description: A class extending PDFEngine to implement PDF creation using TCPDF library, with methods for writing HTML, headers, footers, and configuring PDF options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the TCPDF engine, optionally with a SuiteTCPDF instance, and loading default CSS stylesheet.

methods.name: writeHTML
methods.description: Writes HTML content to the PDF, adding a blank page if necessary.

methods.name: outputPDF
methods.description: Outputs the generated PDF to a file or browser, based on destination parameter.

methods.name: writeHeader
methods.description: Sets the HTML header for the PDF.

methods.name: writeFooter
methods.description: Sets the HTML footer for the PDF.

methods.name: addCSS
methods.description: Adds CSS styles to be included in the PDF.

methods.name: getCSS
methods.description: Returns combined CSS styles wrapped in style tags.

methods.name: writeBlankPage
methods.description: Adds a blank page to the PDF.

methods.name: configurePDF
methods.description: Configures PDF options by loading settings from a PHP config file and applying them to the SuiteTCPDF instance.
